The single source of truth for humans and coding agents (Copilot, Claude,
Cursor, Hermes) working on Kailash OS is
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/AGENTS.md)
in the [`kailash-os`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os) repository
(default branch `master`). The companion guide for the
[`kailash-packages`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages) overlay
repo is
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
there. Tool-specific files (`CLAUDE.md`,
`.github/copilot-instructions.md`) point at these. On any disagreement,
**AGENTS.md wins**.

Read the files at the source — the GitHub-rendered pages stay current:

- [`kailash-os`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/AGENTS.md):
  project map, layer model and the manifest single-home rule, TDD standard
  with the layer map, the ADR process
  ([`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/tree/master/docs/adr)),
  PR contract, labels, security rules (the distribution packages offensive
  tooling — the safety posture is deliberate and testable).
- [`kailash-packages`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages/blob/main/AGENTS.md):
  the overlay flake — pins, packaging shapes and the manifest rules that
  every other artefact generates from.

## Architecture Decision Records

Structural changes carry an ADR in the same PR. Most slices are
leaf-sized: the issue's plan reference IS the design record, and no ADR
is needed. Write one only when the change **introduces a new persistent
artefact**, or **removes or changes one**: a manifest schema field whose
semantics lock, a profile contract, a wire format, a gate script.

The structural record home is deliberately **single**:
[`kailash-os` `docs/adr/`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/tree/master/docs/adr) —
[the process](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/docs/adr/0000-architecture-decision-records.md)
and [the record format](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/docs/adr/0001-record-format.md).
Overlay decisions land there too, with the PR that makes the change.

The rules:

- **Accepted ADRs are immutable.** A change that contradicts an accepted
  ADR supersedes it with a new one. The accepted record is never rewritten.
- **Never invent discussion, deciders, or quotes.** Cite commit/issue
  permalinks, or write "No substantive technical discussion recorded".
- Dependency bumps, docs tweaks, and CI tweaks need no ADR.

This repo also records repo-local prose decisions in its own
[`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-website/tree/main/docs/adr)
(the writing-standard record).

This page does not mirror either file. A mirror drifts the moment the repos
move. The source-of-truth rule (AGENTS.md wins) states the place to look.
